response.justification: Bogdan is a strong, broad full-stack and systems engineer with 15+ years of experience across web, embedded, and distributed systems, but his resume shows no evidence of experimentation platforms, feature flagging, telemetry/metrics infrastructure, or A/B testing systems, which are the core focus of this role. His experience is heavily generalist (CMS, GIS, mobile, product engineering) rather than specialized in growth/experimentation systems at enterprise scale, and there's no indication of cross-team platform leadership for measurement or rollout-risk management.
strengths: 15+ years of diverse technical experience across web, mobile, embedded, and distributed systems
Demonstrated technical leadership, mentoring, and open-source platform ownership (GISCollective)
Strong software craftsmanship background (TDD, CI/CD, testing tools) and experience with high-throughput systems at Dunnhumby
concerns: No demonstrated experience with experimentation platforms, feature flagging, or A/B testing infrastructure
No evidence of telemetry/metrics systems work or statistical/experimental analysis at scale

Career trajectory is generalist full-stack/product engineering rather than specialized growth or measurement platform architecture, and current title (Staff/Senior) doesn't clearly map to Principal/IC6 scope

key_factors.factor: No clear track record of cross-team platform ownership for growth/measurement systems
Strong general engineering depth and leadership/mentoring experience
